tierSetting.name: Council Posture
tierSetting.description: Set how the Council of Ministers presses the union republics. Centralization drives execution at the cost of trust; devolution does the reverse.

options.label: Republic Latitude
options.description: Loosen central direction. Trust rises; plan execution slips.

options.label: Collegial
options.description: Govern to precedent.

options.label: Centralization
options.description: Direct the republics from the centre. Execution sharpens; trust erodes.

tierSetting.name: Coordination Priority
tierSetting.description: Choose what the deputy chairmanship pushes across the ministries: output, or clean administration.

options.label: Output First
options.description: Push production above all. Growth rises; graft goes unchecked.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Coordinate to plan.

options.label: Discipline First
options.description: Police the ministries. Graft falls; output slows.

tierSetting.name: Diplomatic Line
tierSetting.description: Set the union's posture abroad. Détente opens trade at the cost of prestige at home; confrontation does the reverse.

options.label: Détente
options.description: Seek accommodation. Trade widens; hard-line prestige suffers.

options.label: Peaceful Coexistence
options.description: Hold the standing line.

options.label: Confrontation
options.description: Press the union's claims. Pride rises; trade narrows.

tierSetting.name: Force Posture
tierSetting.description: Set the standing posture of the armed forces. Mobilization buys readiness with labour drawn out of the plan.

options.label: Demobilization
options.description: Return conscripts to industry. Hiring improves; readiness falls.

options.label: Standing Forces
options.description: Hold establishment.

options.label: Mobilization
options.description: Call up reserves. Readiness rises; industry loses labour.

regionalTarget.name: Military District Focus
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate garrisons and civil defence in one republic.

emergency.name: Emergency Mobilization
emergency.description: Call up the reserves in one republic under acute threat, sharply raising readiness and confidence.

tierSetting.name: Budget Discipline
tierSetting.description: Set the Ministry's stance on plan financing. Expansion accelerates output and hiring at the cost of price pressure; retrenchment cools costs but slows the plan.

options.label: Retrenchment
options.description: Tighten plan financing. Costs ease, but growth and hiring slow.

options.label: Planned Balance
options.description: Hold financing to the plan targets.

options.label: Plan Expansion
options.description: Accelerate financing of plan targets. Output and hiring improve; prices run hotter.

regionalTarget.name: Republic Financing Priority
regionalTarget.description: Direct plan financing to one republic, lifting growth and hiring there.

emergency.name: Emergency Plan Correction
emergency.description: Deploy an emergency correction for a republic under acute economic stress, sharply lifting output and employment for one window.

tierSetting.name: Internal Security Posture
tierSetting.description: Set how hard the security organs press. Repression buys order at the cost of civil liberties.

options.label: Thaw
options.description: Relax the organs. Liberties widen; crime creeps up.

options.label: Routine Vigilance
options.description: Standing posture.

options.label: Crackdown
options.description: Press the organs hard. Crime falls; liberties narrow.

regionalTarget.name: Militia Concentration
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate militia strength in one republic, cutting crime there.

emergency.name: State of Emergency
emergency.description: Impose emergency powers in one republic, sharply cutting crime at a cost to civil liberties.

tierSetting.name: Plan Emphasis
tierSetting.description: Weight the control figures between heavy industry (Group A) and consumer goods (Group B).

options.label: Group B Priority
options.description: Favour consumer goods. Household costs ease; industrial output slows.

options.label: Balanced Plan
options.description: Hold the control figures.

options.label: Group A Priority
options.description: Favour heavy industry. Competitiveness rises; household costs climb.

regionalTarget.name: Priority Development Region
regionalTarget.description: Name one republic a priority development region in the control figures.

emergency.name: Emergency Plan Reallocation
emergency.description: Reallocate plan resources to one republic in crisis, sharply lifting output and execution.

tierSetting.name: Credit Plan
tierSetting.description: Set Gosbank's credit issuance stance. Loose credit funds the plan faster but builds price pressure; tight credit cools prices at the cost of output.

options.label: Tight Credit
options.description: Restrict enterprise credit. Price pressure eases; output slows.

options.label: Plan Neutral
options.description: Issue credit to plan targets.

options.label: Loose Credit
options.description: Expand enterprise credit beyond plan. Output rises; prices pressure up.

tierSetting.name: Trade Monopoly Posture
tierSetting.description: Direct the state foreign-trade monopoly. An export drive earns growth abroad but tightens goods at home; autarky insulates prices at the cost of growth.

options.label: Autarky
options.description: Minimize foreign exchange. Prices insulate; growth slows.

options.label: Managed Exchange
options.description: Trade to plan requirements.

options.label: Export Drive
options.description: Push exports for hard currency. Growth accelerates; domestic goods tighten.

regionalTarget.name: Export Zone Designation
regionalTarget.description: Designate one republic as an export production zone.

tierSetting.name: Goods Distribution Priority
tierSetting.description: Set the priority of domestic goods distribution. Consumer priority eases household costs but diverts labour from heavy industry; producer priority does the reverse.

options.label: Producer Priority
options.description: Divert goods to industry. Household costs rise; hiring strengthens.

options.label: Plan Allocation
options.description: Distribute goods to plan quotas.

options.label: Consumer Priority
options.description: Prioritize household goods. Costs ease; industrial hiring softens.

regionalTarget.name: Supply Priority Republic
regionalTarget.description: Move one republic to the head of the goods distribution queue.

emergency.name: Emergency Goods Airlift
emergency.description: Airlift consumer stocks into one republic facing acute shortage, sharply cutting costs.

minister_of_agriculture.department: Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Food

tierSetting.name: Procurement Quotas
tierSetting.description: Set collective-farm procurement quotas. Heavy quotas feed the cities cheaply but sap rural output; light quotas do the reverse.

options.label: Light Quotas
options.description: Ease procurement. Rural output improves; urban costs rise.

options.label: Standard Quotas
options.description: Procure to plan.

options.label: Heavy Quotas
options.description: Raise procurement. Urban costs ease; rural output saps.

regionalTarget.name: Agricultural Priority Region
regionalTarget.description: Direct machinery and fertilizer to one republic's farms.

emergency.name: Emergency Grain Release
emergency.description: Release state grain reserves to one republic facing shortage, sharply cutting food insecurity.

minister_of_machine_building.department: Ministry of Heavy Industry and Machine Building

tierSetting.name: Combine Output Setting
tierSetting.description: Set how hard the heavy combines are driven. Over-fulfilment buys output with dirtier air.

options.label: Modernization
options.description: Retool rather than run flat out. Air cleans; output dips.

options.label: Quota Output
options.description: Produce to plan.

options.label: Over-Fulfilment
options.description: Drive the combines past quota. Output rises; air worsens.

regionalTarget.name: Industrial Concentration
regionalTarget.description: Site new combine capacity in one republic: hiring and competitiveness rise, air worsens.

emergency.name: Emergency Production Order
emergency.description: Order the combines in one republic onto emergency shifts. Output surges; the air pays for it.

tierSetting.name: Network Priority
tierSetting.description: Set what the network carries first. Freight priority serves the plan; passenger service serves households.

options.label: Passenger Priority
options.description: Run passenger service first. Transit improves; freight slows.

options.label: Mixed Traffic
options.description: Run to timetable.

options.label: Freight Priority
options.description: Clear the line for plan freight. Efficiency rises; transit suffers.

regionalTarget.name: Line Modernization Priority
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate track and rolling-stock investment in one republic.

emergency.name: Emergency Line Repair
emergency.description: Rush repair crews to one republic's network after a failure, sharply restoring efficiency.

tierSetting.name: Cultural Line
tierSetting.description: Set how tightly cultural output is supervised. A liberal line builds participation; orthodoxy builds pride.

options.label: Liberal Line
options.description: Loosen supervision. Participation and cohesion rise; orthodoxy weakens.

options.label: Supervised
options.description: Standing editorial line.

options.label: Orthodox Line
options.description: Tighten supervision. Pride rises; participation narrows.

regionalTarget.name: Cultural Investment Priority
regionalTarget.description: Build houses of culture and cinemas in one republic.

emergency.name: Emergency Agitation Campaign
emergency.description: Flood one republic with agitators and press, sharply lifting cohesion and pride.

tierSetting.name: Health Service Emphasis
tierSetting.description: Weight the health service between prevention and hospital capacity.

options.label: Prevention Emphasis
options.description: Fund sanitation and screening. Preventable deaths fall; physician coverage thins.

options.label: Standard Service
options.description: Fund to norm.

options.label: Hospital Buildout
options.description: Fund beds and staff. Physician coverage rises; prevention slips.

regionalTarget.name: Health District Priority
regionalTarget.description: Concentrate physicians and clinics in one republic.

emergency.name: Epidemic Response
emergency.description: Deploy mobile medical brigades to one republic in an outbreak, sharply cutting deaths.

minister_of_higher_education.department: Ministry of Higher and Technical Education

tierSetting.name: Institute Intake
tierSetting.description: Weight institute intake between broad enrolment and narrow technical specialization.

options.label: Mass Intake
options.description: Widen enrolment. Enrolment rises; average skill dilutes.

options.label: Standard Intake
options.description: Admit to plan.

options.label: Technical Specialization
options.description: Narrow intake to plan priorities. Skill rises; enrolment falls.

regionalTarget.name: Institute Siting Priority
regionalTarget.description: Site new technical institutes in one republic.

emergency.name: Emergency Cadre Programme
emergency.description: Run an accelerated technical training programme in one republic, sharply lifting skill.

tierSetting.name: Collection Posture
tierSetting.description: Set how hard the service is run. Pressing harder buys reach and cleaner files, and costs the liberties of the people it watches.

options.label: Restrained
options.description: Keep the service on a short leash. Liberties widen; less is learned.

options.label: Standing Watch
options.description: The service's ordinary peacetime footing.

options.label: Aggressive Collection
options.description: Run the service hard at home and abroad. Corruption is rooted out; liberties narrow.

upperChamber.name: State Council
upperChamber.description: A collective head of state exercising standing authority between Assembly sessions.

lowerChamber.name: National Assembly
lowerChamber.description: 400 deputies of the Narodno Sabranie, elected to five-year terms - a single-list body controlled by the ruling communist party within the Fatherland Front.

value.tagline: The Soviet bloc's most loyal member - a one-party People's Republic.
value.descriptor: A one-party socialist state where the ruling communist party's General Secretary governs through the National Assembly; the economy is centrally planned until reform.
